heap.label: Heap
heap.desc: Private anonymous memory, including malloc arenas and large mmap allocations.

image_code.label: Module code
image_code.desc: Executable code of loaded modules (binary and libraries).

unclassified.label: Unclassified
unclassified.desc: Regions of unknown kind (raw dumps are unclassified throughout).

runtime.label: Runtime
runtime.desc: Platform runtime and OS mappings (e.g. Android boot image, ART metadata, device and vDSO mappings). Rarely holds app secrets; excluded by default.

step.title: Choose memory regions
step.description: Pick which kinds of memory to import and analyse. Heap, stack and unclassified memory are where runtime secrets normally live.
step.noPreview: No region preview is available for this input. The selection is still applied to every dump.
step.appliesToAll_one: The selection applies to the {{count}} selected dump.
step.appliesToAll_other: The selection applies to all {{count}} dumps.
step.appliesToAllUnknown: The selection applies to every dump in this directory.

msl.nonDestructive: This is already an .msl file. By default it is left untouched and the selection is applied at analysis time.

raw.writes: The selection decides what is written to the converted .msl. Excluded regions keep their place in the address-space map but carry no bytes.

imageView.reads: This is a memory-image view: it is opened in place, nothing is converted or written.
imageView.processInfo: This process view lists its mappings by kind. The workspace always shows the whole process; to keep only some regions, extract the process to an .msl (memdiver image extract).
imageView.noSelection: Region selection does not apply to a {{kind}} view: it has no process mappings to choose between, so the whole view is analysed.

step.noLayoutInfo: This raw dump has no memory layout; categories can't be separated. Provide a .maps sidecar (same name) to split it into regions.
step.imageDataInfo: Static keys in statically linked binaries live in module data (.data / .bss). Include "Module data" if the target library is linked statically.
step.finishFailed: Could not apply the region selection: {{message}}

runtimeNotice.android_one: Android process: {{count}} runtime region ({{bytes}}) — zygote/boot image, ART metadata and device mappings — is excluded by default. Select "Runtime" to keep it.
runtimeNotice.android_other: Android process: {{count}} runtime regions ({{bytes}}) — zygote/boot image, ART metadata and device mappings — are excluded by default. Select "Runtime" to keep them.
runtimeNotice.generic_one: {{count}} platform runtime region ({{bytes}}) is excluded by default. Select "Runtime" to keep it.
runtimeNotice.generic_other: {{count}} platform runtime regions ({{bytes}}) are excluded by default. Select "Runtime" to keep them.

materialize.label: Write filtered copy (materialize)
materialize.explanation: Writes a new, smaller .msl containing only the selected regions. The copy does not keep the original's integrity hash or byte identity; the original file is left untouched.

encrypted.locked: This container is encrypted. Enter its passphrase or raw key to list its regions and to write a filtered copy.
encrypted.unlocked: Unlocked with the supplied key material.
encrypted.reencryptNote: By default the filtered copy is re-encrypted with the same key, so the same passphrase or key opens it.
encrypted.decryptOutputWarning: Warning: the filtered copy will be written as PLAINTEXT. Anyone with access to the file can read the selected memory, including any secrets it holds.
encrypted.batchHint: Used only for encrypted .msl files in this batch: they are opened with this passphrase or key and the filtered copy is written. Leave empty for plaintext files.

warnings.heading: Import warnings
warnings.secretsOnlyInExcluded_one: {{count}} known secret was found only in excluded regions. Include more categories to keep it.
warnings.secretsOnlyInExcluded_other: {{count}} known secrets were found only in excluded regions. Include more categories to keep them.

upload.selectorHint: Applied to every file in the next batch. Raw dumps are unclassified throughout.
upload.filterAtAnalysis: Stored verbatim; the region selection is applied at analysis time.

maps.label: Memory map (.maps) file
maps.hint: Optional: a /proc/<pid>/maps listing of the dumped process. Use it when the map isn't named like the dump.
